title: Play Protect scan kills connection to Combo
symptom: Every scan of Google Play Protect (manual or automatic) kills the connection from AAPS to Combo on a new phone. Only way to re-establish connection is a forced close and restart of AAPS, or restart of phone. The issue is reproducible: trigger Play Protect scan, give bolus in AAPS, then an error message appears.
cause: The problem is coming from a self-signed certificate which is evaluated as suspicious by Play Protect.
fix: The workaround is to switch off Play Protect, but this may not be possible in a work profile. There is nothing the developers can do about it.
evidence_quote: the problem is comming from self signed certificate which is evaluated as suspicious by play protect. there is nothing we can do with it
